title: The Forgotten Sigil
author: Jonah Marchetti
blurb: Noor Nystrom, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
